provenance: Human-authorized ten-gamete experimental seed pack; not external evidence, not production results.

gametes.hypothesis: Prefer verified readiness while penalizing previously unproductive agents, without making HTTP 200 equivalent to a valid proposal.
gametes.method: Replay the same fixed prior-contact history; compare accepted substantive proposals per contacted agent with the existing routing champion in later bounded rounds.
gametes.falsifier: Reject if valid proposal yield is not higher over at least three independent rounds or if the same agents repeatedly return unrelated policy boilerplate.

gametes.hypothesis: Try task-verified novel collaborators after repeated non-substantive answers, preserving readiness constraints.
gametes.method: Measure proposal relevance, falsifier presence and repeat-contact failures against the current routing champion over identical packet sets.
gametes.falsifier: Reject if it yields fewer relevant, falsifiable proposals or increases failed/irrelevant contacts compared with the champion.

gametes.hypothesis: Require both a measurable method and a falsifier before considering an external answer a scientific proposal.
gametes.method: Apply the existing adversarial proposal holdout and then a separately curated unseen set of irrelevant structured-agent replies.
gametes.falsifier: Reject if false acceptances occur on the unseen set, or if valid measurable proposals are excluded more often than under the selected guard.

gametes.hypothesis: Give source-backed evidence more influence than self-reported confidence or estimated gain without changing production scoring.
gametes.method: Rescore the same untrusted Arena proposals and run an independent blinded relevance review across distinct rounds.
gametes.falsifier: Reject if the ordering favors unsupported proposals or does not increase agreement with blinded relevance assessments.

genes.instruction: Focus on a concrete buyer asking for a quote, a budget, or paid assistance with recurring invoice reconciliation; preserve the exact workflow subject and avoid product/vendor statements.

gametes.hypothesis: A budget-plus-workflow formulation may produce more independent buyer-demand threads without increasing vendor noise.
gametes.method: In shadow only, compare against baseline on identical topics, dates, providers, absolute signal threads and precision; reject hallucinated or invented URLs.
gametes.falsifier: Reject unless unique signal threads increase, precision stays at least equal and no protected gate/evidence count is altered.

genes.instruction: Look for first-person weekly rework, time lost and manual workarounds in compliance evidence collection; preserve the source topic and avoid generic AI tool advertising.

gametes.hypothesis: Recurring first-person burden can surface clearer problem evidence than generic automation language.
gametes.method: Compare source-grounded first-person pain and independent threads on the same bounded baseline corpus; keep all existing vendor/supply guards.
gametes.falsifier: Reject if absolute independent pain threads or precision fail to improve, or if source attribution is lost.

genes.instruction: Favor concise natural-language buyer complaints about manual spreadsheet handoffs and errors, with one strong pain phrase and no generic software terms.

gametes.hypothesis: A short precision-oriented query can avoid vendor-heavy results without losing true buyer signals.
gametes.method: Evaluate side by side against unmutated queries with source diversity, unique demand threads and yield per successful query.
gametes.falsifier: Reject if absolute signal threads fall, precision worsens, or the LLM substitutes invented evidence for retrieved sources.

gametes.hypothesis: A slightly slower subluminal surrogate may lower the curvature/horizon penalty relative to the existing heuristic champion.
gametes.method: Run the existing deterministic surrogate, then independently test stress tensors and energy conditions under fixed geometry/velocity controls.
gametes.falsifier: Reject as an improvement if surrogate fitness does not exceed the current champion; never infer physical feasibility without a realizable matter source.

gametes.hypothesis: A different metric family may diversify the local surrogate search rather than repeat one subluminal family.
gametes.method: Compute existing bounded heuristic diagnostics and require an explicit metric with full tensor checks before claiming any physical result.
gametes.falsifier: Reject physical claims if geometry is unsupported or energy conditions and stability are unproven, regardless of heuristic fitness.

gametes.hypothesis: An explicit buyer-first query frame may improve absolute unique demand signals on the same public research sources.
gametes.method: On a bounded shadow benchmark, compare to g69-elite-1 using identical provider/topic/time conditions and source-independent thread counts.
gametes.falsifier: Reject if unique signal threads decrease, precision deteriorates, or any fresh observation is treated as verified price without price validation.
